beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Blind Specialist asks how excellent local decisions can produce a failing whole.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It defends deep expertise while examining the consequences that disappear between professional boundaries.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book calls accumulated missing integration awareness debt, without pretending it has one universal score.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Historical failures and proposed collaborative structures test that diagnosis.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers gain a reason to inspect the seams while keeping the microscope.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A department can meet its target by moving costs beyond its reporting boundary.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Another team inherits the consequences without receiving authority over the original decision.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book calls such postponed integration awareness debt because its costs can accumulate.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: More detailed local dashboards may leave that missing relationship untouched.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The example explains why replacing a weak specialist with a stronger one may be insufficient.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The constructive chapters preserve narrow excellence while assigning responsibility for the interfaces between components.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Different specialists need enough shared understanding to recognize when another perspective is missing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A shared model remains contestable, rather than becoming the property of an omniscient coordinator.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Historical failures test why incentives, dissent, and permission to interrupt matter alongside better information.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed architecture aims for peripheral vision, not a final generalist who knows everything.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with Keep the Microscope and its defense of the expertise the book wants to connect.
